HIGH FLOOR WITH FULL SEA N BURJ KHALIFA VIEW | VACANT

|| Ready to move ||

The rental price is AED 228,000 p/year, three Bedroom plus maid.

This is a knockout lateral apartment in a verdant canal side location at Business Bay In Dubai. It meets all expectations with its radiant design, never-ending 1976.36 sq.ft floorplan, and spectacular canal view that is going to steal your attention.

There are tonnes of attractive qualities that couple to add delightful detail to this home. It has 3 bedrooms including 3 ensuite bathrooms, a magnificent living room, a family room, maid's room, a spacious horseshoe kitchen, and a protected patio that's great for grabbing a bit of fresh air.

All the amenities you'll need are right there for you. There's a knee-deep children's pool, a shimmering jacuzzi and a stunning community swimming pool for having a dip on a roastingly hot day. You've got a health club, a tennis court and a gym for your sport and health related interests. And there's a clinic, a community retail centre, restaurants, bars and a supermarket for all your local errands.
